title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS, run gate and log phase metered at 2^97: 2^96.511923748

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+64/20000+(K/2^64) 2^97.032247347 < 2^96.511923748 units (C=20,000 instructions), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). It is pairing result 9c3ae97c (source b5fbf9d3) with a run gate: one fresh 64-bit coin before any work opens the run iff it is below K = 12861354580073806744, the least K with (K/2^64) x 0.559368 >= 0.39; a closed run costs 64 instructions and fails. Both logarithms share one phase meter of 2^97 units that aborts as failure and is charged in every opened run; the descent recurrence (expected 2^95.805191) enters only success, via Markov P(cap) <= 0.436845, giving opened-run success 0.559368. The score is an expectation, not an every-run bound, and the parent's robustness to 2.5x descent work is given up. Everything is charged once for this target.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=adaptive,side,root_seed,order regenerates bounded recursive whole-ball evidence. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
